'''Jisao Hamora''' is one of [[Gawyn Trakand]]'s [[Younglings]]. 


== Appearance ==
He has dark eyes and is still young enough not to have to shave regularly. He has earned the silver tower on his collar from the coup of the White Tower.

== Activities ==
He is with Gawyn when they are sent to act as escort for a group of [[Aes Sedai]] that make an alliance with the [[Shaido]].{{ref/book|6|p}} He acts as Gawyn's second in command and is in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]].{{ref/book|6|55}}

After Dumai's Wells the Younglings make their way to [[Dorlan]]. He helps Gawyn raid the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] army camped outside of [[Tar Valon]].{{ref/book|12|4}}
